subject: Log who downloads data from the downloadButton (through a form)

messages.author: 69658a5d047f38b4
messages.subject: Log who downloads data from the downloadButton (through a form)
parts:
Hi everyone,

I have several shiny apps allowing to select some data, plot it, and download it through the downloadButton() function. I would like to keep track of who downloads what data. One solution I envisioned is there:
  https://gist.github.com/jiho/89d948b5ca4c264c1c6b
i.e.
- add an email input
- show the download button only if the email input is filled (in the example, with a very specific address)
- in the download handler function, write some information about the download in a text file

Regarding this specific solution I would like to know:
- how I can check for a valid email in the email field to show the conditional panel. As far as I understand, this condition is written in javascript. There are plenty of email validation scripts written in javascript. Can I use one and how?
- I would like the info to be written in a specific log file, ideally based on the path/name of the current app for example. Is this something I can get access to from within the code?
- can I get the IP of the user who downloads the data (this would be useful to compute stats on the locations and check for repeated access from the same location)?

However, this solution looks more like a workaround than a real solution. Does anyone have a better suggestion?

Thanks in advance for your help. Sincerely,

Jean-Olivier Irisson
